compute_histogram: compute histogram over numerical data using polars with configurable bin edges
generate_bins: generate bin edges for float and int columns with adaptive bin sizing
min_max_mean_median_std: compute minimum, maximum, mean, median, and standard deviation from a polars dataframe column
compute_float_column_statistics: compute numerical statistics including histogram for a float column in a polars dataframe
compute_string_column_statistics: compute statistics for a string column, detecting datetime, categorical, or text type
